nameInvalid.title: Invalid connection name
nameInvalid.message:
The connection name can't be empty: it identifies the connection in the workbook's queries.

Give it a name.

dialog.noServer: No server: add one with “Manage servers…”
dialog.name: Connection name

help.lattis: No password is saved: the connection uses your session on the server (Account menu in the title bar), and whatever your rights let you read there. As a query source, it is used only for reading (on a replica when the server advertises one).
help.web: The token is never saved in the workbook; it is only sent to addresses that start with the connection's address
help.bearer: : Bearer is added to a bare token
help.db: The password is never saved in the workbook. The connection is used only for reading
help.selectOnly: SELECT queries only, transaction always rolled back

select.label: Choose columns
select.hint: Keep some columns, in the order you want

type.label: Data type
type.hint: Change a column's type (a value that can't be converted becomes empty)

filter.label: Filter rows
filter.hint: Keep the rows that meet conditions

distinct.label: Remove duplicates
distinct.hint: Keep one row per value (of all columns or of some)

split.label: Split column
split.hint: Split a text column by delimiter

addcolumn.label: Custom column
addcolumn.hint: New column calculated by a SQLite expression ([Column] refers to a column)

pivot.label: Pivot
pivot.hint: Turn a column's values into columns

merge.label: Merge
merge.hint: Join another query or a table on common columns

append.label: Append
append.hint: Add the rows of another query or of a table at the end

cmp.ge: is greater than or equal to
cmp.le: is less than or equal to

join.left: Left outer (all rows from the first, matching rows from the second)
join.right: Right outer (all rows from the second)
join.anti: Left anti (rows from the first with no match)

password.title: Password
password.stored: This workbook wants to connect with your password saved on this computer.
password.storedHelp: Allow it if you know this workbook: the permission is remembered for it on this computer. A workbook received from an unknown source shouldn't get it.
password.asked: The server asks for a password.
password.never: It is never saved in the workbook.

host.noExcelTable: No table of two or more rows in this workbook.
host.refreshedAll: {n, plural, one {# query refreshed} other {# queries refreshed}}
host.loaded: Table “{table}”: {n, plural, one {# row loaded} other {# rows loaded}}
host.deletedTable: Query “{name}” deleted; table {table} stays on its sheet (Ctrl+Z to undo)

rename.label: Rename
rename.empty: Enter a name for the connection.

source.passwordRequired: Password required to list the tables.

need.xlsxTable: Choose a table from the workbook.
need.connection: Choose a connection and a table (or write a SQL query).
need.fileTable: Choose a table (or write a SQL query).
need.formula: Write a formula that starts with =.
need.url: The address must start with http:// or https://.

source.title: Source

recordPath.label: Record path
recordPath.placeholder: empty: the root or its only array; e.g. data.items

json.help: Array of objects, or one JSON object per line (NDJSON). Nested objects become “parent.child” columns.

parquet.help: Each column of the file gives a column (“parent.child” for a struct; a list becomes text).

source.queryHelp: The query starts from the other query's result (reference): changing the other query also changes this one.

web.help: Headers are saved in the workbook: a token or an API key goes through a Web connection (kept in the system keychain).

sql.label: SQL query (read-only)
sql.dbHelp: Filter here if you can: the query runs on the server, the steps afterwards in Lattis.
sql.fileHelp: The file is opened read-only; the steps apply afterwards.
sql.workbookHelp: As in the SQL tab: the query is reread on every refresh.
sql.sheet: Cell[A1] addresses without a sheet are read from “{sheet}”.

formula.label: Formula (dynamic table)
formula.help: The table recalculates when its sources change (without steps; with steps, on refresh, F5).

need.name: Enter a name.
need.nameExpr: Enter a name and an expression.
need.mergeOther: Choose the query or table to merge.
need.keys: Choose the matching columns on both sides.
need.appendOther: Choose the query or table to append.

filter.help: Numbers and dates are typed as in the grid (3,5; 31/12/2026). Contains, begins with and ends with are not case-sensitive.

distinct.help: No column checked: a row is a duplicate if all its values are identical.

select.help: Check the columns to keep; ↑ ↓ change their order.

replace.help: In a text column, each occurrence is replaced; elsewhere, the whole value.

addcolumn.name: New column name
addcolumn.help: Available columns: {columns}. Examples: [Price] * 1.2, upper([City]), [LastName] || ' ' || [FirstName], CASE WHEN [Amount] > 100 THEN 'large' ELSE 'small' END.

merge.columns: Columns to take from the second (none checked: all except the matching columns):

append.help: Columns are matched by name; a column missing on one side stays empty.

pivot.help: 50 distinct values at most; the other columns group the rows.

closeLoad.label: Close & Load
closeLoad.hint: Save the query and load its result into a table

save.hint: Save the query without loading it (connection only)

cancel.hint: Close the query editor without saving the changes (the workbook stays open)

undo.label: Undo
undo.hint: Undo the last action on the steps (Ctrl+Z)

asc.hint: Sort by the chosen columns, ascending

desc.hint: Sort by the chosen columns, descending

editor.title: Query Editor

close.tooltip: Cancel: close the query editor without saving (the workbook stays open)
close.aria: Cancel and close the query editor

header.tooltip: {name}: {type} — right-click or ▾: column menu; Ctrl or Shift: several columns

status.size: {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}, {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
status.sample: preview computed on the first 1,000 rows of each source

editor.help: A new step is inserted after the chosen step. Click a column header to choose it (Ctrl or Shift: several); its ▾ or a right-click opens the column menu.
